domain-understand-ai.title: Understand AI
domain-understand-ai.description: Build durable mental models for how AI behaves, where it fails, and what software or humans must still guarantee.

domain-build-ai.title: Build AI
domain-build-ai.description: Engineer AI-native software, knowledge systems, Agents, evaluation and production reliability.

domain-use-ai.title: Use AI
domain-use-ai.description: Apply AI to real outcomes such as writing, research, knowledge work and business workflows.

branch-ai-foundations.title: AI Foundations
branch-ai-foundations.description: Shared foundations for understanding model behavior.

branch-ai-limits.title: Limits & Guarantees
branch-ai-limits.description: Separate model capability from runtime facts and application guarantees.

branch-ai-native-software.title: AI-Native Software
branch-ai-native-software.description: Software workflows designed around AI-assisted and agentic development.

branch-vibe-coding.title: Vibe Coding & Agentic Coding
branch-vibe-coding.description: Move from ad-hoc generation to specification, context, review and verification.

branch-llm-apps.title: LLM Application Engineering
branch-llm-apps.description: Build reliable model-backed product behavior and context flows.

branch-knowledge-systems.title: Knowledge Systems
branch-knowledge-systems.description: Design systems that collect, retrieve, update and govern knowledge.

branch-rag.title: RAG & Retrieval
branch-rag.description: Select and ground evidence with explicit retrieval and authority policy.

branch-agents.title: Agent Engineering
branch-agents.description: Build bounded systems that act, observe, verify and escalate.

branch-agent-runtime.title: Agent Runtime
branch-agent-runtime.description: Control loops, state, recovery and long-running work.

branch-production-ai.title: Production AI
branch-production-ai.description: Turn prototypes into observable, recoverable and defensible systems.

branch-eval-reliability.title: Evaluation & Reliability
branch-eval-reliability.description: Use evidence to diagnose failures and make release decisions.

branch-create-with-ai.title: Create with AI
branch-create-with-ai.description: Use AI for meaningful creative workflows rather than one-shot generation.

branch-long-form-creation.title: Long-Form Creation
branch-long-form-creation.description: Research, plan, draft and verify coherent long-form work.

branch-knowledge-work.title: Knowledge Work
branch-knowledge-work.description: Use AI to collect, structure, reason over and maintain knowledge.

branch-knowledge-base.title: AI Knowledge Base
branch-knowledge-base.description: Create living knowledge systems that stay retrievable and current.

concept-probabilistic-behavior.title: Probabilistic model behavior
concept-probabilistic-behavior.summary: Fluent output is not a deterministic application guarantee.

concept-model-vs-runtime-fact.title: Model claim vs runtime fact
concept-model-vs-runtime-fact.summary: What the model says happened must be separated from what the runtime can verify.

concept-context-management.title: Context management
concept-context-management.summary: Select, order, compress and refresh context according to the task.

concept-specification-before-generation.title: Specification before generation
concept-specification-before-generation.summary: Define intent, constraints and acceptance evidence before asking AI to produce an artifact.

concept-ai-code-review.title: AI code review
concept-ai-code-review.summary: Treat generated code as an untrusted change set that requires review and evidence.

concept-source-authority.title: Source authority
concept-source-authority.summary: Freshness and authority may disagree, so systems need an explicit source-priority policy.

concept-retrieval-pipeline.title: Retrieval pipeline
concept-retrieval-pipeline.summary: Retrieval is a multi-stage evidence-selection system, not one vector-search call.

concept-agent-loop.title: Act → observe → verify loop
concept-agent-loop.summary: An Agent is a bounded control loop that must decide whether to continue, recover or stop.

concept-workflow-decomposition.title: Workflow decomposition
concept-workflow-decomposition.summary: Break work into stages only when decomposition improves control, verification or parallelism.

concept-timeout-ambiguity.title: Timeout ambiguity
concept-timeout-ambiguity.summary: A missing response describes what you observed, not whether the remote side committed the action.

concept-idempotency-boundary.title: Idempotency boundary
concept-idempotency-boundary.summary: Repeated intent must not duplicate irreversible side effects.

concept-evaluation-evidence.title: Evaluation evidence
concept-evaluation-evidence.summary: Release decisions need representative tasks, observable evidence and an aligned verifier.

concept-long-form-consistency.title: Long-form consistency
concept-long-form-consistency.summary: Long-form AI output needs explicit control of facts, terminology, voice and cross-section dependencies.

concept-knowledge-base-lifecycle.title: Knowledge-base lifecycle
concept-knowledge-base-lifecycle.summary: A useful knowledge base needs ingestion, retrieval, updating, authority and evaluation over time.

concept-human-review-boundary.title: Human review boundary
concept-human-review-boundary.summary: Place human review where error cost, ambiguity or irreversibility justifies interruption.

edge-probability-runtime.rationale: Probabilistic behavior must be understood before reasoning about runtime guarantees.

edge-context-retrieval.rationale: Retrieval only helps when the system knows how evidence will enter and compete inside context.

edge-spec-review.rationale: A review needs a specification to judge whether the generated change is acceptable.

edge-source-retrieval.rationale: A retrieval pipeline needs source-authority rules before ranking evidence.

edge-agent-workflow.rationale: Workflow decomposition builds on understanding the Agent control loop.

edge-timeout-idempotency.rationale: Timeout ambiguity explains why idempotency is required for safe retries.

edge-review-evaluation.rationale: Code review creates concrete evidence that can feed evaluation.

edge-retrieval-kb.rationale: Retrieval is one core subsystem inside a maintained knowledge base.

edge-workflow-longform.rationale: Long-form consistency improves when work is decomposed into verifiable stages.

edge-context-longform.rationale: Long-form creation depends on deliberate context management.

edge-human-code-review.rationale: Human review belongs at coding boundaries where automated evidence is insufficient.

edge-human-longform.rationale: Human review is useful when long-form factual or editorial risk becomes expensive.

edge-source-evaluation.rationale: Evaluation quality depends on the authority of the evidence used as ground truth.

path-agent-engineering.title: Agent Engineering
path-agent-engineering.description: From Agent loops to reliability and evaluation.
path-agent-engineering.goal: Build and defend a production Agent architecture.
path-agent-engineering.deliverable: A production Agent decision backed by reliability and evaluation evidence.

path-vibe-coding.title: Vibe Coding & Agentic Software Engineering
path-vibe-coding.description: Turn AI coding from ad-hoc generation into a controlled engineering workflow.
path-vibe-coding.goal: Use AI to change real codebases while preserving architecture, tests and review quality.
path-vibe-coding.deliverable: A reviewed AI-generated change with explicit specification and evidence.

path-write-book-ai.title: Write a Book with AI
path-write-book-ai.description: Use AI across research, planning, drafting and consistency review.
path-write-book-ai.goal: Produce coherent long-form work with source-backed claims and controlled context.
path-write-book-ai.deliverable: A book-length draft with provenance, workflow and consistency review.

path-build-knowledge-base.title: Build an AI Knowledge Base
path-build-knowledge-base.description: Create a living knowledge system instead of a static document dump.
path-build-knowledge-base.goal: Build a knowledge base that retrieves current, authoritative evidence and can be evaluated.
path-build-knowledge-base.deliverable: A knowledge-base design with retrieval, update and evaluation policy.

milestone-agent-reliability.title: Handle ambiguous failure and side effects

token-playground.title: Token Playground
token-playground.promise: See how model constraints shape what the system can receive and generate.
token-playground.debrief: Model behavior remains probabilistic and context remains finite.
token-playground.transferPrompt: A model gets a larger context window. Which selection problems still remain?

rag-failure.title: The Broken RAG Pipeline
rag-failure.promise: Diagnose why weak evidence wins even when the right source exists.
rag-failure.debrief: Retrieval quality is a pipeline property: context, authority and evaluation must agree.
rag-failure.transferPrompt: The newest source conflicts with the legally authoritative source. Which should win?

agent-reliability.title: The $47,000 Retry
agent-reliability.promise: Stabilize an Agent runtime where retry duplicates an irreversible action.
agent-reliability.debrief: Timeout describes observation; idempotency determines whether repeating intent is safe.
agent-reliability.transferPrompt: An order API times out after the provider may have committed. Design a safe recovery path.

ai-code-review-mission.title: Your AI Changed 17 Files
ai-code-review-mission.promise: Review an AI-generated change that passes tests but hides an architectural regression.
ai-code-review-mission.debrief: Generated code is an untrusted proposal; specification, review and evidence decide whether it should merge.
ai-code-review-mission.transferPrompt: The same change now touches a migration and permission boundary. What extra evidence is required?

write-book-with-ai-build.title: Write a Book with AI
write-book-with-ai-build.promise: Build a source-backed workflow from research through consistency review.
write-book-with-ai-build.debrief: AI writing quality depends on source authority, context, decomposition and human review—not one perfect prompt.
write-book-with-ai-build.transferPrompt: A key source changes halfway through drafting. What must be invalidated or rewritten?

knowledge-base-build.title: Build an AI Knowledge Base
knowledge-base-build.promise: Design a knowledge system that stays retrievable, current and evaluable.
knowledge-base-build.debrief: A knowledge base is a lifecycle system: source authority, retrieval, updating and evaluation must work together.
knowledge-base-build.transferPrompt: A frequently retrieved document becomes obsolete. Design the update and regression path.
